diagnostics.message: The Lambda function can be created before its AMI-housekeeper inline policy is attached. Make the function depend on this policy so its execution role permissions are established before the function is ready to be invoked.

When tracing is enabled, the Lambda function can be created before its X-Ray inline policy is attached, leaving tracing enabled without the required execution permissions. Order the function after this policy.

When VPC subnets are configured, Lambda creation can race ahead of attachment of AWSLambdaVPCAccessExecutionRole. Lambda needs these EC2 permissions to configure its VPC networking, so it should depend on this attachment.

The EventBridge target can be installed before the Lambda resource-based permission, allowing an enabled rule to attempt invocation before it is authorized. Order target creation after the permission.
